description:
Save a reusable schema to the workspace for use across future extractions.

USE WHEN: the user confirms a schema/template they want to reuse across documents.
NOT FOR: a single one-off extraction (pass the schema inline to talonic_extract instead).
ARGS: `name`; `definition` — a JSON Schema ({type:'object',properties:{...}}) or a flat {field:'type'} map.
RETURNS: the saved schema with id and short_id. Pass either to talonic_extract as `schema_id`.

definition.description: Schema definition. Most reliable: full JSON Schema {type:'object', properties:{...}}. Also accepted: a flat key-type map {field_name:'string', amount:'number'} which the API normalises.

description.description: Optional description of what this schema extracts and when to use it.

name.description: Human-readable name for the schema, e.g. 'Standard Invoice'.

name: talonic_save_schema

definition.description: Final schema definition as stored, normalised by the API.

description.description: Schema description, or null when the schema was saved without one. The API explicitly maps the absent case to null (see SchemaResponse in openapi.yaml).

id.description: UUID of the newly saved schema.

version.description: Schema version (1 for new schemas; increments on update).

title: Save Talonic Schema
